[b]Mouth for War[/b]

The 2028 National Diet Elections of Hebasviriil were completed on March 9 2028, with all 910 Charecavai seats, 182 Archarecavai seats, and President seat up for election. 

The incumbent Progressive Party of Hebasviriil won 209 Charecavai seats- forcing the creation of the Right Coalition between the Reactionary Party, Independent Party, Adonai Party, Frey Veraehcapin, Chascai Party, and Denai Party, winning 473 of the votes, and securing a majority. The Apaliin and Progressive Party were then forced into creating the Center Coalition, holding 437 seats. 

Of the Right Coalition, the Reactionary Party was the most popular, inserting ultranationalist and fascist youth-leader Ka'vari Saradir into the position of President. Known for her apologism of Hebasviri genetic altering, ethnic cleansing, war crimes, and suppression of left-wing politics.

Already, Saradir has announced her intention to rebuild the Hebasviri Military in response to increased aggression in the region, as well as a desire to restart the conflict against the southern 'Nueva Hebasvira' separatist movement, herself calling the movement "An evil mob of commie bastards."

Saradir replaces Jo'urabi Kahraradir on May 3rd, commemorating 79 years since the conclusion of absolute imperial rule in Hebasviriil, though if the Reactionaries have their way, there may not be an eightieth anniversary.
